facts.fact: Togo First reports that the Lomé Data Centre, operated by SIN, lets firms rent a half-rack or a full rack to host their data, and the SIN chief says a smaller client can get a cheaper cloud offer.
Togo First describes the Lomé Data Centre, run by SIN, as certified Tier III by the Uptime Institute, with 99.982% service availability.

note: No cloud region stated; the private-cloud offer is run from the Lomé Data Centre by SIN and ST Digital.
